title: In a time format nn is the minute, and mm after hh is the minute too
query: EVALUATE VAR DT = DATE ( 2020, 1, 2 ) + TIME ( 15, 30, 0 ) RETURN ROW ( "nn", FORMAT ( DT, "hh:nn:ss" ), "mm", FORMAT ( DT, "hh:mm:ss" ) )

source.quote: You can use simple date formatting composing the format string
source.supports: the example shows hh:nn:ss and hh:mm:ss both as 15:30:00

source.quote: If mm immediately follows h or hh , minute rather than the month is displayed.
